column1: # Any-Chart Reports Lab: GENERIC rules, applied to every chart (including custom charts)
# after the chart's own rules, only to accounts still unclassified.
# Only pcg_type values that mean the same thing in every shipped chart are listed.
# Deliberately NOT listed: CAPITAL (equity in US/CA, equity + long-term debt in AD/ES-CAT),
# and mixed groups such as CAPIT, THIRDPARTY, FINAN: those need per-chart rules.
# Several values in a match column are separated by |. Empty match column = any.
